parts.text: During a soccer match, in the first half, team A scores 4 goals while team B scores 2 goals fewer than team A.
Simultaneously, a spectator in the stands is keeping track of the number of times the ball hits the crossbar, which happens to be 5 times.
In the second half, team A scores 1/4 of the number of goals scored by team B, which scores 4 times the number of goals it scored in the first half.
Meanwhile, the spectator notes that the ball hits the crossbar 3 times more than in the first half.
What's the total number of goals scored in the match, disregarding the number of times the ball hit the crossbar?
